journey.name: Descriptor call to action
journey.description: With no descriptor loaded, verifies the app actively asks for one: a persistent snackbar on the Node tab, an empty state on the Transactions tab, and a deep link that lands on Settings with the Descriptors section already expanded and scrolled into view. Requires a clean install — descriptors persist in the node's data directory, so uninstall the app first if a descriptor has ever been loaded on this network.

actions.action: Launch the Mandacaru app and wait for the splash screen to dismiss (poll until nav_node is present)
Poll for up to 30 seconds until snackbar_add_descriptor appears on the Node tab; it is absent until the node's RPC server answers listdescriptors twice, so do not fail on the first layout dump
Dismiss the snackbar with its ✕ (target the "Dismiss" content-description) and verify snackbar_add_descriptor disappears without a descriptor being loaded
Verify the "Add descriptor" button (button_add_descriptor) is present instead of the grey lookup hint
Verify nav_settings is now the selected navigation item and the descriptor field (input_descriptor) is visible without scrolling
Verify a "Descriptor loaded successfully" snackbar appears (target by text)
Verify snackbar_add_descriptor is no longer present
Verify button_add_descriptor is no longer present and the app has not crashed
